title: Film & TV
subject: Screen trivia
blurb: Directors, ships, hotels and one coffee shop. The pack most likely to start an argument.

questions.prompt: Who directed Jaws, E.T. and Jurassic Park?
questions.hint: The shark in the first of those barely worked, which is why you hardly see it.

questions.prompt: Which actor plays Captain Jack Sparrow?
questions.hint: He based the performance on Keith Richards, to the studio's considerable alarm.

questions.prompt: Which animated film follows a clownfish named Marlin searching for his son?
questions.hint: Two words, and the second is the son's name.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the coffee shop in Friends?
questions.hint: Two words, and it is a pun on a New York park.

questions.prompt: Which actor plays Iron Man in the Marvel films?
questions.hint: He was a famously risky piece of casting in 2008, and the whole run of films hung on it.

questions.prompt: In which television series would you find the Iron Throne?
questions.hint: Three words. Adapted from novels by George R. R. Martin.

questions.prompt: Which 1997 film starred Kate Winslet and Leonardo DiCaprio aboard a doomed liner?
questions.hint: It held the record for the highest-grossing film for twelve years.

questions.prompt: Who played Hermione Granger in the Harry Potter films?
questions.hint: She was nine years old at the first audition.

questions.prompt: The US version of The Office is set in which Pennsylvania city?
questions.hint: The paper company's branch is there, and the city now has a real welcome sign quoting the show.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the hotel in The Shining?
questions.hint: One word, and it is what the building does to the valley below it.

questions.prompt: Which director made Pulp Fiction and Kill Bill?
questions.hint: He worked in a video rental shop before his first film.

questions.prompt: In Star Wars, what is the name of Han Solo's ship?
questions.hint: Two words, and the first is commonly misspelled with one N too few.
